Method of Attack: OGNL Injection vulnerability leading to Remote Code Execution (RCE)
Double evaluation flaw in OGNL expressions causing security degradation and RCE
Discoverer: Masato Anzai of Aeye Security Lab
Impacted Systems: Struts 2 versions from 2.0.0 up to and including 2.5.29
Attack Vector: Forced OGNL evaluation on untrusted user input in tag's attributes
